prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every truck crash — the right attorney depends on the facts of your case and what you need (trial experience, record of large truck settlements/verdicts, resources to handle complex discovery, communication style, etc.). I can, however, help you find a strong lawyer and explain how to choose one.

Immediate steps if you were recently in a truck accident
- Get medical care right away and keep all records.  
- Call police and preserve the crash report.  
- Preserve photos, dash-cam/phone video, truck number, driver info, and witness contacts.  
- Don’t give recorded statements or sign releases for any insurer until you speak with an attorney.  
- Contact a lawyer quickly — Texas has a two-year statute of limitations for most injury claims.

What to look for in a truck-accident lawyer
- Specific trucking experience: knowledge of FMCSA rules, hours-of-service logs, black box/ELD data, and cargo/maintenance issues.  
- Trial experience and demonstrable verdicts/settlements in truck cases.  
- Firm resources: investigators, accident reconstruction experts, medical experts, and capacity to litigate against large carriers/insurers.  
- Board certification: Texas Board of Legal Specialization certification in Personal Injury Trial Law is a strong plus.  
- Good client reviews and peer-recognition (Super Lawyers, AVVO, Martindale-Hubbell).  
- Contingency-fee agreement and clear fee structure.  
- Clear communicator who returns calls and explains strategy.

How to find and vet lawyers
- Start with searches/ratings on SuperLawyers, AVVO, Martindale-Hubbell, and Google Business.  
- Ask for referrals from friends, family, or other lawyers.  
- Call 3–5 firms for free consultations and compare.  
- Ask for recent truck-case results and whether they’ll personally handle your case or assign it to a team.

Questions to ask in the initial consult
- How many truck accident cases have you handled? How many go to trial?  
- Have you handled cases against major carriers/owner-operators? Any large verdicts/settlements you can share?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? Will you use experts and accident reconstruction?  
- What’s your fee? (Typically contingency: no fee unless you recover.)  
- What is your estimated timeline and likely case value range?  
- How will you communicate updates and how often?

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of highly rated Dallas-area truck-accident firms (based on 2024 reputational sources) — tell me your ZIP or neighborhood.  
- Draft an email/phone script you can use to contact lawyers.  
- Walk through what evidence to collect from your crash to improve your case.
